cross_task_conclusions.text: D1 did not support the original commodity residual model and carried a protocol limitation: the nested selection was not fully executed and six of thirty origin-horizon cases used the conservative fallback.
D3 corrected the issue-month timing contract and established the registered operational reference baselines.
D4 did not demonstrate incremental World Bank commodity signal under the fixed operational specification.
D5 did not demonstrate incremental EPPO fuel-oil signal under the only structurally supported pooled interaction architecture.
No candidate satisfied the conditions required to open the locked test.
The appropriate final system reference is therefore baseline-only.
Baseline-only means a registered evaluation reference - not a production deployment, and not proof of superiority over every trivial forecast.

locked_test.required_language: The locked final test was intentionally left unopened because no independently preregistered candidate earned access through development evidence.

prohibited_collapses.development_evaluation_into_production_v: A development walk-forward is not a production validation, and no model was deployed.
prohibited_collapses.inconclusive_into_no_effect: An interval that crosses zero is a failure to demonstrate, not a demonstration of failure.
prohibited_collapses.latest_vintage_into_real_time_backtestin: Latest-vintage targets cannot reproduce what was knowable at the time. The project is release-aware, not point-in-time on the target side.
prohibited_collapses.not_supported_into_disproven: A model that did not beat its benchmark has not disproved the hypothesis it encoded.
prohibited_collapses.selected_reference_into_proven_superiori: D3's persistence benchmarks are the REGISTERED reference. The paired comparison against no-contraction was inconclusive at both horizons.
prohibited_collapses.unresolved_into_absent: A quantity nobody measured is unresolved. Recording it as zero asserts a measurement that was never made.
